attributes.content:
**EL-RSP-P5 RLCM_ECU forwarding reaction**

RLCM_ECU shall run the RLCM_Lighting TurnLightControl handler within 5 ms of frame reception.

description: Platform part of EL-RSP-1.4.1 (RLCM_Lighting_IndicatorResponseTime), through ComputeAllocation_RLCM_Lighting, which places RLCM_Lighting on RLCM_ECU.
5 ms equals the LIN master time base of RLCM in rearlight.ldf (5 ms, 1 ms jitter), the period at which the master task runs anyway.
metadata.name: RLCM_ECU_Lighting_Forwarding
